entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, and you've reached VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something, and I expect this to be quick. I've already wasted enough time with your company.
I can certainly help you with a return, sir. To pull up your account, could I please get your order number?
It's VF-998-451. And let's not play games. I want to return this helmet I bought. Your policy says 90 days, so just process it.
Okay, I see the order right here for the V-Pro helmet, delivered 14 days ago. Just for my notes, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
A preference? The issue is the color is a complete joke! It looked bright red on your website, but it's some kind of faded, sad-looking magenta. I wouldn't be caught dead in it.
I understand the color wasn't what you expected. I just need to confirm, is the item still in its original condition?

Listen to me. The box is unopened. I saw the helmet through the plastic window and knew immediately it was wrong. Honestly, if you can't get the color right, it makes me question the overall safety of the product. Are you going to process this or do I need to speak to a manager? I'm about to light up your social media.
That won't be necessary, sir. I can definitely take care of this for you right now. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for this helmet.

Okay, I've checked our system. You are correct, the V-Pro helmet is a standard item and falls under our 90-day return policy. Since it's only been 14 days, you are well within the window for a full refund.
Okay. Good. That's what I thought. So what do I do now?

I have just authorized the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account. Simply print it, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be issued back to your original payment method.
Fine. As long as I get my money back. That's all I needed.
Absolutely. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
